card.name: Linking word before large intestine
card.fires_on: The word "or" (or "the") right after "small intestine" or before "small bowel" in lists of gut parts, where "large" or "small" comes next. Seen in NSAID gastrointestinal warning text.

modes.label: or before large intestine
modes.description: The word "or" after "small intestine" in the NSAID GI warning list, just before "large intestine".
modes.example: perforation of the stomach, small intestine<< or>> large intestine, which can be fatal.

modes.label: the before small bowel
modes.description: The word "the" before "small bowel" in imaging contrast dosing text.
modes.example: Volumes up to 750 mL are recommended for examination of<< the>> small bowel.
